description: This file is a unit test for the ReadWriteLock synchronization primitive in the core library, using the Google Test framework to verify read and write lock and unlock functionality.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A synchronization primitive that allows multiple readers or a single writer, used in the test to verify lock functionality.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on the ReadWriteLock object.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a read lock on the ReadWriteLock object.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on the ReadWriteLock object.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a write lock on the ReadWriteLock object.
